name: Charter
district: Prologue (the appointment and the risk-appetite statement), Budget, Suppliers, Policy, and the Board report
blurb: Four weeks after the Compact-wide incident, the Compact Board appoints its first CISO: you. Set the risk appetite with the Board, then the budget: one fixed sum across the register’s risks, a fair case for an upgrade, and the Board’s decision. Then the suppliers: tiers, contract clauses within one envelope, and a supplier’s incident told from the Compact’s own records. Then policy: an exception register with owners, expiries and reviews, a policy the Board approves, and standards measured against their own words. Then the Board report: one page to the Compact Board, built from your own records and read line by line against them. Next: The finale.
